blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Knowledge distillation compresses large language models into compact students that preserve aggregate metrics, yet the mechanistic consequences of depth-reduction distillation remain largely uncharacterized. This work applies linear CKA, logit lens analysis, attention pattern decomposition, sparse autoencoder feature statistics, and activation patching to compare GPT-2 and its six-layer student DistilGPT-2 across two canonical circuits: the Indirect Object Identification (IOI) circuit and the Greater-Than (GT) circuit. The results reveal a compression-collapse dichotomy: the IOI circuit suffers complete mechanistic collapse (DistilGPT-2: 35.2% accuracy vs. 94.8%, zero name-mover preservation), while the GT circuit survives with 87.7% task performance recovery through active remapping of the teacher's layer-9 comparison head into student layer~4 (mean Pearson r = 0.945). These findings demonstrate that circuit compressibility governs mechanistic survival under distillation, and that aggregate metrics are insufficient diagnostics for circuit integrity.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Large language models (LLMs) exhibit remarkable capabilities, but their sheer scale poses significant computational challenges for deployment. Knowledge distillation trains a compact student on soft targets from a larger teacher, enabling compression while mimicking the teacher’s generalization ( Hinton et al., 2015 ) . While distillation often successfully preserves aggregate metrics like validation perplexity, it remains an open question how severe architectural truncation affects the precise, underlying algorithms the model has learned. Prior work establishes that compression can degrade circuit integrity and alter feature representations ( Lindner et al., 2023 ; Bereska and Gavves, 2024 ) , but the specific mechanistic consequences of distillation-induced depth reduction remain largely uncharacterized. Mechanistic interpretability provides a framework for addressing this blind spot by reverse-engineering neural networks into human-understandable computational subgraphs, known as circuits ( Elhage et al., 2021 ; Olah et al., 2020 ) .
blocks.zh: 大型语言模型(LLMS)表现出显著的能力,但其规模本身对部署构成重大的计算挑战. Knowledge discription(知识蒸馏)从一个更大的老师身上训练一个紧凑的学生, 以软目标为对象, 虽然蒸馏常常成功地保留了诸如验证的模糊性这样的聚合度度度量,但是,严重的建筑断流如何影响模型所学到的精确的,基础的算法仍然是一个未解的问题. 先前的工作确定,压缩可降低电路完整性并改变特征表示(Lindner等人,2023年;Berreska和Gavves,2024年),但蒸馏引起的深度减少的具体机械后果基本上仍未定性。 机械解释性提供了一个框架,通过反向工程神经网络,将这一盲点变成人类可以理解的计算子图,称为电路(Elhage等人,2021年;Olah等人,2020年)。

blocks.en: This work investigates the mechanistic impact of depth-reduction distillation. It focuses on DistilGPT-2 ( Sanh et al., 2019 ) , a 6-layer student distilled from the 12-layer GPT-2 teacher ( Radford et al., 2019 ) . This drastic depth reduction poses a critical structural challenge: many well-documented higher-order reasoning behaviors in GPT-2 depend crucially on late-layer interactions. For example, both the Indirect Object Identification (IOI) circuit ( Wang et al., 2022 ) and the Greater-Than (GT) circuit ( Hanna et al., 2023 ) rely heavily on highly specialized attention heads located in layers 9-11. Because the student model is only 6 layers deep, these components have no direct structural counterpart. This raises two central research questions: do the internal representations of DistilGPT-2 remain similar to those of GPT-2 after depth halving (RQ1), and does distillation preserve the computational circuits responsible for higher-order reasoning, and if so, how does the student compensate for the absence of essential upper-layer components (RQ2).
blocks.zh: 这项工作调查了深度还原蒸馏的机械影响. 它专注于DistilGPT-2(Sanh等人,2019年),是一名从12级GPT-2教师中蒸馏出来的6级学生(Radford等人,2019年). 这种急剧的深度降低带来了严重的结构挑战:GPT-2中许多有详细记载的更高顺序的推理行为关键地依赖于晚期的相互作用. 例如,间接对象识别(IOI)电路(Wang et al., 2022年)和大唐(GT)电路(Hanna et al., 2023年)都严重依赖于位于9-11. 由于学生模型只有6层深,这些组件没有直接的结构对应物. 这引起了两个中心研究问题:DistilGPT-2的内部表现是否仍然与深度减半(RQ1)后的GPT-2相似,蒸馏是否保留了负责高序推理的计算电路,如果是的话,学生如何补偿缺少基本的上层组件(RQ2).

blocks.en: To answer this, a suite of representational and causal probes, including representational similarity analysis, direct logit attribution ( Elhage et al., 2022 ) , and activation patching ( Meng et al., 2022 ) , is applied to track circuit preservation across the distillation gap. A natural question is whether circuit preservation matters at all if task performance is maintained. We argue it does, for two reasons. First, the IOI and GT circuits are among the most causally validated subgraphs in any language model, established through convergent evidence from activation patching, path patching, and direct logit attribution across independent studies ( Wang et al., 2022 ; Hanna et al., 2023 ) ; they are not arbitrary correlational subgraphs but confirmed computational mechanisms. Second, and more critically, the IOI result we report is not a performance degradation but a sign reversal: DistilGPT-2 achieves a negative mean logit difference ( − 0.467 -0.467 ), meaning the model is actively misled rather than merely uncertain, failure mode entirely invisible to aggregate metrics, the core motivation for circuit-level analysis.
blocks.zh: 为了回答这一点,一套代表物和因果探针,包括代表物相似性分析,直接对帐归属(Elhage等人,2022年),以及激活补丁(Meng等人,2022年),用于跟踪跨越蒸馏缺口的电路保存. 一个自然的问题是,如果任务性能得到维持,电路保护是否完全重要。 我们提出,原因有两个。 首先,IOI和GT电路是任何语言模型中最经因果关系验证的子图之一,通过激活补丁,路径补丁,以及跨独立研究的直接对账归属的趋同证据而建立(Wang等人,2022年;Hanna等人,2023年);它们不是任意关联的子图,而是确认的计算机制. 其次,更重要的是,我们报告的IOI结果不是性能退化,而是标志性逆转:DistilGPT-2实现负平均对数差(−0.467-0.467),意味着该模型被积极误导,而不只是不确定的,故障模式对聚合度量完全看不见,是电路级分析的核心动机.

blocks.en: We find a striking dichotomy in how different computational mechanisms survive depth halving. One circuit collapses entirely, the other is actively remapped into the student’s shallower stack, detailed in § 5 and § 6 . By contrasting a circuit that collapses with one that compresses, this sheds light on the inductive biases of the distillation process.
blocks.zh: 我们发现,不同的计算机制是如何在深度减半的情况下存活的,这是一个引人注目的二分法。 其中一条线路完全崩溃,另一条则被积极重塑到学生较浅的堆栈中,详见§5和§6. 通过将一个崩溃的电路与一个压缩的电路作对比,这揭示了蒸馏过程的诱导偏差.

blocks.en: The main contributions are as follows: • Provide a comprehensive, circuit-level analysis comparing a depth-distilled model to its teacher, quantifying the mechanistic impact of structural truncation. • Demonstrate that complex, multi-stage computational pipelines (such as the IOI circuit) fail to survive standard distillation when critical late-layer components are excised. • Discover that the student model can successfully compress and remap specific cognitive algorithms (such as the GT circuit), migrating late-layer mechanisms into its available upper layers to preserve task functionality.
blocks.zh: 主要贡献如下: 提供综合的,电路水平的分析,将深沉的模型比作它的老师,量化结构截断的机械影响. • 证明复杂、多阶段的计算管道(如IOI电路)在关键后期部件被切除时无法经受标准蒸馏。 • 支助 发现学生模型可以成功压缩和重新映射特定的认知算法(如GT电路),将后层机制迁移到其可用的上层,以保存任务功能.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Mechanistic Interpretability of GPT-2. Circuit analysis decomposes neural networks into functionally distinct sub-networks using causal interventions ( Olah et al., 2020 ; Cammarata et al., 2020 ) . In GPT-2, two circuits are directly relevant to this work: the Indirect Object Identification (IOI) circuit ( Wang et al., 2022 ) , a multi-stage pipeline of name-mover, S-inhibition, and induction heads spanning layers 0-11; and the Greater-Than (GT) circuit ( Hanna et al., 2023 ) , in which year-encoding heads feed comparison heads in layers 9-11. Activation patching ( Meng et al., 2022 ) , and path patching ( Goldowsky-Dill et al., 2023 ) establish causal responsibility at the head and pathway level, respectively, while Direct Logit Attribution ( Elhage et al., 2022 ) provides a complementary non-interventional decomposition. Sparse autoencoders ( Bricken et al., 2023 ; Cunningham et al., 2023 ) extend circuit analysis to the feature level by decomposing polysemantic residual-stream activations into monosemantic feature dictionaries.
blocks.zh: GPT-2的机械解释. 电路分析利用因果关系将神经网络分解为功能上独立的子网络(Olah等人,2020年;Cammarata等人,2020年)。 在GPT-2中,两条电路与这项工作直接相关:间接对象识别(IOI)电路(Wang et al., 2022年),一个多阶段的管道,即名模,S-inhibition,以及跨越0-11层的诱导头;以及大通(GT)电路(Hanna et al., 2023年),其中年编码头在9-11. 激活补丁(Meng等人,2022年),路径补丁(Goldowsky-Dill等人,2023年)分别确定了头部和路径层面的因果责任,而Direct Logit Attribution(Elhage等人,2022年)则提供了互补的不干预分解. Sparse 自动编码器(Bricken等人,2023年;Cunningham等人,2023年)通过分解多语义残流活化为单语义特征词典,将电路分析延伸至特征水平.

blocks.en: Knowledge Distillation. Knowledge distillation trains a compact student on soft targets from a larger teacher, enabling it to mimic the teacher’s generalization while maintaining a smaller architecture ( Hinton et al., 2015 ) . DistilGPT-2 ( Sanh et al., 2019 ) reduces GPT-2’s depth to six layers by initializing from every other teacher layer and combining a language-modeling and distillation objective, thereby preserving embedding dimensionality throughout.
blocks.zh: 知识消沉. Knowledge distractation从一个更大的老师身上训练一个紧凑的学生,学习软目标,使其能够模仿老师的概括,同时保持一个较小的建筑(Hinton等人,2015年). DistilGPT-2(Sanh等人,2019年)将GPT-2的深度降低到6层,方法是从其他教师层中初始化,并结合一个语言模型和蒸馏目标,从而在整个过程中保持嵌入维度.

blocks.en: Compression and Interpretability. Prior work establishes that compression can degrade circuit integrity and alter feature representations ( Lindner et al., 2023 ; Bereska and Gavves, 2024 ) , but focuses primarily on pruning and quantization ( Hatefi et al., 2025 ; Chhabra and Khalili, 2025 ) . SAE-based analysis reveals representational changes under compression can be invisible to standard metrics ( Malik et al., 2025 ; Ayonrinde et al., 2024 ) . Most closely related, Wu et al. (2024) ; Haskins and Adams (2025) ; Baek and Tegmark (2025) show distillation induces simplicity bias, component reorganisation, and unique feature directions across model families.
blocks.zh: 压缩与解释. 先前的工作确定,压缩可以降低电路完整性并改变特征表示(Lindner等人, 2023年;Berreska和Gavves, 2024年),但主要侧重于推敲和量化(Hatefi等人, 2025年;Chhabra和Khalili, 2025年)。 基于SAE的分析显示,在压缩过程中的表示变化对于标准衡量标准是看不见的(Malik等人,2025年;Ayonrinde等人,2024年)。 关系最密切的有:Wu等人(2024年);Haskins和Adams(2025年);Baek和Tegmark(2025年)显示蒸馏会诱导简单偏差,组件重组,以及跨模范家族的独特特征方向.

blocks.en: 3 Background and Models
blocks.zh: 3 背景和模式

blocks.en: Mechanistic interpretability ( Elhage et al., 2021 ; Olah et al., 2020 ) reverse-engineers neural network algorithms at the level of attention heads and residual-stream components. The residual stream ( Elhage et al., 2021 ) treats activations as a running sum of additive contributions from each head and MLP, enabling direct logit attribution (DLA). A circuit ( Olah et al., 2020 ) is a minimal subgraph causally sufficient for a given behaviour. The IOI and GT circuits both depend critically on upper-layer interactions structurally absent in a six-layer student.
blocks.zh: 机械解释 (Elhage等人,2021年;Olah等人,2020年) 注意头级和残余流组件级的逆向工程神经网络算法. 残留流(Elhage等人,2021年)将激活作为每个头和MLP的添加剂贡献的运行总和,从而能够直接对帐归属(DLA). 一个电路(Olah et al., 2020)是一个最小的子图,在因果关系上足以满足特定的行为. IOI和GT电路都严重依赖六层学生结构缺失的上层互动.

blocks.zh: 4 方法

blocks.en: To answer RQ1, debiased linear CKA (§ 4.1 ), logit lens analysis (§ 4.2 ), and attention pattern analysis (§ 4.3 ) are applied. All experiments use n = 1,000 n{=}1{,}000 samples from the TinyStories validation set ( Li and Eldan, 2023 ) , filtered to [ 64,256 ] [64,256] tokens, processed via TransformerLens ( Nanda and Bloom, 2022 ) on a single NVIDIA L4 GPU.

blocks.en: 5.6 Indirect Object Identification Circuit Preservation
blocks.zh: 5.6 间接物体识别 电路保护

blocks.en: Table 4: Full name-mover head matching results across discovery and evaluation sets.
blocks.zh: 表4:各发现组和评价组的全名-模头比对结果。

blocks.en: GPT-2 achieves a mean logit difference of 2.942 ± 1.797 2.942\pm 1.797 and 94.8 % 94.8\% accuracy on the IOI task. DistilGPT-2 fails completely: logit difference − 0.467 ± 1.335 -0.467\pm 1.335 , accuracy 35.2 % 35.2\% . This is below the 50 % 50\% chance level for a two-name choice (one-sided binomial test, n = 1,000 n=1{,}000 , p < 0.001 p<0.001 ), so the student is systematically wrong rather than guessing. The negative logit difference indicates the model actively favours the subject name over the indirect object, a sign reversal, not merely a performance gap. One possible explanation, which we do not test, is a repeated-name heuristic: in IOI prompts the subject appears twice and the indirect object once, so a model that favours frequently seen names would produce exactly this sign. DLA confirms no component provides meaningful positive attribution the student’s peak layer contribution is 0.0168 0.0168 vs GPT-2’s 2.74 2.74 at layer 9, roughly 160 × 160\times smaller, and all IOI circuit classes score approximately zero (Figure 3 ). Activation patching of the 7 available heads (Table 4 : three previous-token, two duplicate-token, two induction) yields negligible recovery; induction heads show a small effect (Cohen’s d = 0.298 d=0.298 , p < 0.001 p<0.001 ) but the critical PT → \to IND pathway is non-significant ( d = 0.031 d=0.031 , p = 0.329 p=0.329 ). Name-mover matching (Figure 4 ) identifies DistilGPT-2 candidates with CKA between 0.18 0.18 and 0.52 0.52 , and attention-pattern correlation that ranges from weakly negative ( r ≈ − 0.15 r\approx-0.15 for the layer-9 heads) to strongly positive ( r ≈ 0.44 r\approx 0.44 – 0.78 0.78 for the layer-10 and layer-11 heads). However, no matched head reproduces IO-selective attention: name-mover score preservation is at most 0 % 0\% for every match, so pattern similarity alone does not indicate that the name-mover function has been remapped. This confirms that soft-label distillation does not force remapping of critical late-layer IOI functionality.

blocks.en: 6.1 RQ1: Representational Similarity After Depth Halving
blocks.zh: 6.1 RQ1: 深度曲折后的代表性相似性

blocks.en: Three consistent patterns emerge across CKA, logit lens, attention analysis, and SAE feature statistics (§ 4.1 –§ 4.4 ).
blocks.zh: CKA、对数透镜、注意力分析、SAE特征统计(第4.1节+4.4)。

blocks.en: Early layers are near-identical, late layers diverge. Proportional-mapping CKA and per-head attention cosine similarity are both near 1.0 at the first layer pair, consistent with the student’s every-other-layer initialisation, while same-index CKA collapses to 0.314 by layer 5 and SAE feature survival falls to 0.086 with reconstruction error 34.9 × 34.9\times the teacher’s. The logit lens shows the same trend: same-index layer-matched representations become markedly less predictive of the next token with depth.
blocks.zh: 早期的地层是接近相同的,晚期的地层是不同的. 比例映射的CKA和每头的注意力余弦相似性在第一层均接近1.0,这与学生的每层初始化一致,而同指数的CKA崩溃率则降至0.314乘第5层,而SAE特征生存率则降至0.086,重建错误为34.9×34.9\时为教师. logit透镜显示了同样的趋势:同指数层匹配的表示方式随着深度而明显减少对下一个符号的预测.

blocks.en: The student compresses rather than truncates. The contrast between mapping schemes is itself informative: the same-index collapse at layer 5 is largely recovered under proportional mapping, showing that DistilGPT-2’s final layer is more similar to GPT-2’s layer 11 than to GPT-2’s layer 5. The logit lens reinforces this proportional-mapping relative accuracy exceeds 1 at every layer but the last and functional SAE survival recovers to ≈ 0.53 \approx 0.53 at mid- and late-pipeline pairs (magnitude drift δ ≈ 0.51 \delta\approx 0.51 – 0.55 0.55 ).
blocks.zh: 学生压缩而不是截断. 映射计划之间的对比本身是信息化的:第5层的同指数崩溃在比例映射下基本恢复,显示DistilGPT-2的末层与GPT-2的11层比GPT-2的5层更相似. logit镜头强化了这种比例映射的相对精度在每一层都超过1,但最后和功能性的SAE存活恢复到≈0.53~约0.53的中后管对(放大漂移δ0.51\delta\约0.51~0.55).

blocks.en: 6.2 RQ2: Circuit Preservation Under Depth Halving
blocks.zh: 6.2 RQ2: 深度回转下的电路保护

blocks.en: Distillation preserves circuits whose critical computations fit within the student’s available depth and destroys those whose pipelines extend beyond it.
blocks.zh: 蒸馏能保存其关键计算符合学生可用深度的电路,并摧毁其管道超过电路的电路。

blocks.en: The IOI circuit collapses completely. The negative mean logit difference (§ 5.6 ) is a sign reversal, not merely a performance gap, and DLA confirms no component provides meaningful positive attribution. Activation patching of the available heads yields negligible recovery, and name-mover head matching yields candidates with moderate CKA but no matched head reproduces IO-selective attention, despite some showing moderate-to-high attention-pattern correlation. The IOI circuit suffers from a mechanistic collapse: induction heads show a small, significant effect, but without downstream name-movers, the pipeline cannot complete.
blocks.zh: IOI电路完全崩溃. 负平均对数差异(§5.6)是标志性反转,而不仅仅是性能差距,DLA确认没有组件提供有意义的正归属. 激活现有头部的补丁会产生可忽略不计的恢复,命名-覆盖头部匹配适中CKA但无匹配头部复制IO-选择性注意,尽管有些表现出中度对高度的注意-型号相关. IOI电路受到机械崩溃的影响:诱导头显示一个小而显著的效果,但没有下游命名-mover,管道无法完成.

blocks.en: The GT circuit survives through active remapping. In contrast, DLA reveals a coherent shift of peak contribution from the teacher’s layer 9 to the student’s layer 4, and the student’s L4H1 replicates the attention pattern of GPT-2’s L9H1 with mean Pearson r = 0.945 r=0.945 , a level of alignment that stands in stark contrast to the IOI name-mover matching results.
blocks.zh: GT电路通过主动重映可存活. 相比之下,DLA揭示了从教师第9层到学生第4层的峰值贡献的一致转变,学生的L4H1以平均值Pearson r = 0.945 r = 0.945 ,复制了GPT-2的L9H1的注意模式,这种水平的校对与IOI命名-模比结果形成鲜明对比.

blocks.en: Compressibility as a candidate explanation. This dichotomy is consistent with a circuit compressibility account: circuits whose critical computations fit within the student’s available depth survive, while those whose pipelines extend beyond it collapse. The result is structural incompleteness rather than graceful degradation. Confirming compressibility as a general principle requires testing intermediate-depth circuits across additional model pairs, which we identify as the most important extension of this work.
blocks.zh: 压缩作为候选解释. 这种二分法与电路压缩账户一致:其关键计算适合学生可用深度的电路生存下来,而管道延伸超过其坍塌的电路生存下来. 结果是结构不完整,而不是优雅的退化。 确认可压缩性为一般原则,需要测试跨额外模型对的中间深度电路,我们确定这是这项工作最重要的延伸.

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en:
This work presented a mechanistic interpretability study of depth-reduction distillation, comparing GPT-2 and DistilGPT-2 across representational and causal probes. The finding is a compression-collapse dichotomy: distillation preserves circuits whose critical computations fit within the student’s available depth and destroys those whose pipelines extend beyond it.
These findings suggest that aggregate metrics like perplexity are insufficient for assessing mechanistic preservation; practitioners should evaluate circuit integrity directly and use distillation objectives that align intermediate representations at functionally critical layers.
blocks.zh:
这项工作提出了对深度还原蒸馏的机械解释性研究,对GPT-2和DistilGPT-2进行了各种代表性探测和因果探测的比较。 其发现是压缩-缩合的二分法:蒸馏能保存其关键计算符合学生可用深度的电路,并摧毁其管道超出电路的电路。
这些调查结果表明,诸如迷惑性等综合度量度不足以评估机械保存;从业人员应当直接评价电路完整性,并使用使中间表示在功能关键层一致的蒸馏目标.

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: The analysis is restricted to two circuits and a single teacher-student pair. Whether the compression-collapse dichotomy generalises to other circuits, distillation methods, or model families remains open.
blocks.zh: 分析仅限于两个线路和一个师生单对. 压缩-缩合的二聚体泛化到其他电路,蒸馏方法,或者模型家族是否仍然开放.

blocks.en: The IOI null result does not rule out DistilGPT-2 solving a residual version of the task via an alternative mechanism. Future work could apply causal scrubbing ( Chan et al., 2022 ) or automated circuit discovery ( Conmy et al., 2023 ) to search for such subgraphs.
blocks.zh: IOI的无效结果不排除DistilGPT-2通过替代机制解决剩余版本的任务. 未来的工作可以采用因果擦除法(Chan等人,2022年)或自动电路发现法(Conmy等人,2023年)来搜索这种子图.

blocks.en: Using pre-trained GPT-2 SAEs as a fixed reference basis introduces a systematic blind spot to student-only features. Training student-specific SAEs would resolve this.
blocks.zh: 将预训的GPT-2 SAEs作为固定的参考基础,引入了系统化的盲点,只面向学生的功能. 专门培训学生的高级行政人员可以解决这个问题。

blocks.en: A complete mechanistic account of GT circuit survival would require verifying the full circuit beyond the key head match (L4H1 ↔ \leftrightarrow L9H1). This includes the year-encoding heads { ( 0 , 1 ) , ( 1 , 5 ) } \{(0,1),(1,5)\} and the causal paths from year encoding through comparison to output computation, tested with both activation patching and path patching. Confirming that DistilGPT-2 replicates not just the comparison head’s attention pattern but the full causal chain would substantially strengthen the claim of circuit survival.
blocks.zh: 完整的GT电路生存的机械化说法需要验证超过密钥头匹配的全电路(L4H1 QQ\\左右旋L9H1). 这包括年编码头{(0,1),(1,5)}}{(0,1),(1,5)}}和从年编码到输出计算之间的因果路径,通过激活补丁和路径补丁进行测试. 确认DistilGPT-2不仅复制了比较头的注意模式,而且完整的因果链将大大加强电路生存的主张。

blocks.en: A.1 Distillation Objective Interventions
blocks.zh: A.1 消沉

blocks.en: The analysis characterises the mechanistic consequences of soft-label distillation but does not intervene in the distillation process itself. An important open question is whether alternative objectives, intermediate-layer matching, attention transfer, or circuit-aware distillation losses could preserve circuit integrity during depth reduction. Preliminary evidence from the GT result suggests that even standard distillation can accidentally preserve circuits that are structurally compatible with the student’s depth; targeted objectives might extend this to deeper circuits, such as IOI.
blocks.zh: 分析特征为软标签蒸馏的机械后果,但不干预蒸馏过程本身. 一个重要的未决问题是,替代目标、中间层匹配、注意力转移或电路感知蒸馏损失能否在深度减少期间保持电路完整性。 GT结果的初步证据表明,即使标准蒸馏也能不慎保存与学生深度结构相容的电路;目标目标可能将此扩展到更深的电路,如IOI.
